enrichment.core_claim: Five decades of brainwave music and multi-brain performance suggest music lets us inhabit the space between mind, language, and a nonlocal consciousness field.
enrichment.ask_question: What happened musically in Ringing Minds when several brains were treated as one performer?
enrichment.challenge_question: What in the EEG performance work bears on the claim of a nonlocal consciousness field, as opposed to shared attention?
